title: Pure Sky Striker
summary: Pure Sky Striker control build centered around Raye and Roze piloting versatile Link Aces while keeping the Main Monster Zones clear for high-impact Spells. Backed by modern support, the deck escalates in power as the graveyard fills with Spells, gaining powerful secondary effects and multi-target removal.

summary.title: Starters
points: Sky Striker Ace - Raye tributes itself as a Quick Effect to Special Summon a Sky Striker Ace Link Monster from the Extra Deck to the Extra Monster Zone, and revives itself from the GY whenever a face-up Sky Striker Ace Link Monster leaves the field.
Sky Striker Mobilize - Engage! searches any Sky Striker card from your Deck, and if you have 3 or more Spells in your GY, draws 1 additional card without once-per-turn restriction.
Pillar of the Future - Cyanos discards a Spell Card to Special Summon itself from the hand, and Special Summons Sky Striker Ace - Roze from your Deck or GY.
Sky Striker Mecha - Hornet Drones Special Summons 1 Sky Striker Ace Token to provide instant 1-card Link material while your Main Monster Zones are empty.

Sky Striker Mobilize - Linkage! sends a card you control to the GY to Special Summon a Sky Striker Ace Link Monster from your Extra Deck, and buffs it by 1000 ATK if both Raye and Roze are in your GY or field.

summary.title: Opening: Raye
steps: Normal Summon Sky Striker Ace - Raye and Link Summon Sky Striker Ace - Kagari to retrieve a Sky Striker Spell from your GY.
Link Summon Sky Striker Ace - Hayate to attack directly and send Sky Striker Mobilize - Engage! from your Deck to the GY.
In Main Phase 2, Link Summon Sky Striker Ace - Shizuku and Set your defensive Quick-Play Spells.
During the End Phase, trigger Shizuku to search Sky Striker Mecha - Widow Anchor or Sky Striker Mobilize - Engage!.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Sky Striker Mecha - Widow Anchor negates the effects of an opponent's face-up effect monster until the end of the turn, and if you have 3 or more Spells in your GY, takes control of that monster until the End Phase.

Combined Maneuver - Engage Zero! is a Link-2 boss that negates the effects of an opponent's monster with 2500 or more ATK, and destroys all monsters the opponent controls if both Raye and Roze are in the GY.
Surgical Striker - S.P.E.C.T.R.A. is a Link-4 boss that banishes 2 Spells from your GY to negate and destroy an opponent's card or effect.
Sky Striker Ace - Camellia sends a Sky Striker card from your Deck to the GY once per turn, and sends an opponent's monster to the GY when it leaves the field.

Sky Striker Special Maneuver - Lemnisgate! shuffles Sky Striker Ace monsters and Spells from your GY into the Deck to return opponent cards to the hand, and Link Summons an Ace as a Quick Effect from the GY.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Sky Striker Mecha Modules - Multirole prevents the opponent from responding to your Spell activations, and Sets used Sky Striker Spells with different names from your GY during the End Phase.
Sky Striker Maneuver - Afterburners! destroys a face-up monster, then optionally destroys a Spell or Trap if you have 3 or more Spells in the GY.
Sky Striker Maneuver - Jamming Waves! destroys a Set Spell or Trap, then optionally destroys a monster without targeting if you have 3 or more Spells in the GY.
Sky Striker Mecha - Shark Cannon banishes a monster from the opponent's GY, or Special Summons it to your field if you have 3 or more Spells in the GY.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Pot of Desires and Radiant Typhoon Vision from page combo lines, as well as the Mitsurugi hybrid engine, are omitted to maintain pure Sky Striker consistency.
